target_customer: Manufacturers, commodity traders and banks in carbon-intensive supply chains that must report emissions
problem: Companies in heavy industry could not measure supply chain carbon emissions accurately, which exposed them to incoming carbon taxes and penalties.
product_category: Carbon accounting and supply chain emissions software

founders.name: Adam Hearne
founders.background_notes: YC page says 12 years in mining and 3 years at Amazon managing complex supply chains. The company site says the founders came from Rio Tinto, BCG and Amazon without attributing roles.

founders.name: Roheet Shah
previous_startups: Housing fund in Damascus, Syria (outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: YC page: consultant at BCG on oil and gas projects, managed Amazon UK smart home business. Role COO from the company about page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mapping commodity supply chains to asset-level emissions needs data integration and modelling with some hard data-quality parts, but no research-grade problem.

defensibility.rationale: Asset-level emissions datasets and customer reporting workflows are hard to copy quickly, though carbon accounting methods are public.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent buying or copying it was found in the sources opened; the sector later saw consolidation among other carbon accounting vendors.

market_need_then: Companies faced incoming carbon taxes and penalties, which the YC description names as the driver in 2020. The EU CBAM later raised demand further.

branding.domain_note: Operates on carbonchain.com; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B enterprise language about emissions accounting and CBAM reporting.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself or community found; the name is descriptive and shared with other carbon and blockchain terms.

outcome_analysis: CarbonChain is still active as of the sources opened. It raised a seed at the end of 2020 and a $10M Series A in April 2023 co-led by USV and Voyager, riding regulatory demand for supply chain emissions data. Founders with mining and supply chain backgrounds fit the commodity niche. No sign of distress or exit was found, so the later outcome is unknown.
